description: A genuine, unresolved frequency conflict between two encounters in the same week, with no explanation reconciling the two - unlike the taper/titration cases above.
input_notes: Visit note: Patient reports taking Gabapentin 300 mg three times daily for neuropathic pain, with good relief.
Emergency department note (same week): Medication reconciliation lists Gabapentin 300 mg twice daily; patient unable to clarify exact regimen at time of visit due to pain.

possible_inconsistencies: Gabapentin frequency differs between the visit note (three times daily) and the emergency department note (twice daily), and the patient was unable to clarify which is correct.
expected.summary: Gabapentin dose is consistent at 300 mg, but the documented frequency conflicts between two encounters in the same week, with no clear resolution.
